gaps.note: Measured against the 208 x 142 mm ONT in Product Guide Figure 5-13: 304 mm wide over hinge and latch, 335 to 337 mm tall over the bottom mounting tab, plus or minus about 4 mm. The Alcatel-Lucent 7302 ISAM Information Manual 3FE 55873 AAAA TCZZA Table 28-7 p1042 prints 343 x 305 x 109 mm for an I-211M-L ONT within an outdoor enclosure it does not name. Width agrees; height differs by 7 mm; depth is from that table alone and is untested. The manifest carries the measured width and height and the table's depth.

bottom-layout.note: The two cable entries are centred 62 and 247 mm across the front (Figure 5-13, grommet centres); the photographs of 3FE54221AC show each as a round port of roughly 40 mm at the split between frame and door. Their size and their position front to back are read by eye from angled photographs.

chassis.note: NO DOCUMENT HELD STATES A SIZE; width and height are measured against the ONT in Figure 5-13 and are estimates. METHOD: the ONT in that figure is 208 x 142 mm (Product Guide Table 4-8) and its outline measures 1689 x 1168 px, which gives 8.12 px/mm down and 8.23 across - the figure is orthographic to 1.3 percent - and 8.17 px/mm is used for both. At that scale the housing is 304 mm across from the hinge pins to the latch tab (2486 px; the frame alone 274 mm) and 335 mm from the crest of the frame to the foot of the bottom mounting tab (2736 px; the frame alone 323 mm). Figure 5-10, scaled by the same frame width, gives 304 and 337 with the door shut. Carried: 304 x 336. ERROR: 0.65 percent of scale either way plus about 1.5 mm of edge picking, so plus or minus 3.5 mm on the width and 4 mm on the height. A CANDIDATE WAS TESTED AND NOT ADOPTED: the Alcatel-Lucent 7302 ISAM Information Manual 3FE 55873 AAAA TCZZA, Table 28-7 p1042, gives 13.5 x 12 x 4.3 in (343 x 305 x 109 mm) for an I-211M-L ONT within an outdoor enclosure, without naming the enclosure. Its width agrees with the measurement to 0.3 percent; its height is 7 mm (2 percent) more than either figure gives, outside the error. The disagreement is recorded as a gap. DEPTH cannot be measured from a front elevation and the photographs are angled; 109 mm is that candidate's figure, carried as an estimate because nothing else gives one.

colours.note: From two photographs of the sibling 3FE54221AC by counting pixels: the door reads #8d8e8e (median of 501,120 px) in one and #909091 (574,464 px) in the other - a mid grey under studio light, carried as #8e8f8f. The grommets are black.

front-layout.note: Product Guide Figure 5-10 p54, the housing closed, at 5.80 px/mm from the 274 mm frame. The door fills the frame; a crease runs across it about 98 mm down; a recessed label panel 107 x 126 mm sits in its lower right. Two hinge knuckle groups on the left stand 10.9 mm outside the frame. The latch tab on the right stands 19.3 mm outside it, about 123 to 218 mm down, lettered TELCO, with the pin-in-hex security screw, a second fastener and a padlock hole below. The arched top and bowed bottom of the door are drawn as a rounded rectangle.

interior.note: Product Guide Figures 5-11 p55 and 5-13 p57, door open, at 8.17 px/mm. The ONT stands upright, 142 across by 208 tall, its top face outwards and its lamps down its left side, 29 to 172 mm across and 50 to 257 mm down, between a retainer above and one below; its ports face right towards the fibre spools. Two slack spools about 60 mm across, an SC connector holder under the top mounting tab, a four-position line protector block (Figure 5-11: cable assembly multipair) at the right, grommets over the two cable entries at the bottom, and a mounting tab top and bottom on the centre line. The figure and the text disagree about the side: step 4 says to place the ONT on the right side of the enclosure and both figures draw it on the left; the figures are followed. The interior is a part of its own (nokia/3fe54221-interior@1) set back in the frame, and the door (nokia/3fe54221-door@1) lies over it; with the door open the door itself, which swings out to the left, is not drawn.

ont-seat.note: The ONT is a device of its own (nokia/xs-010xr-p) and a bay accepts components, not devices, so it is not seated here: the place it occupies is a dashed outline on the interior's back wall, and no ONT is drawn. The guide calls the housing a universal outdoor ONT enclosure; which other ONTs it takes is not stated in anything held.

rating.note: The guide's sample safety label (Figure 3-1 p25 and the table on p24) reads Type 3R enclosure - Rainproof, under UL and TUV. No table rates 3FE54221AH by part number, and the data sheet says only that the ONT in the enclosure withstands 55 C outside; the guide's Table 4-10 says 58 C.

sources.note: Nokia ONT XS-010XR-P Product Guide, 3TN-00113-AAAA-TCZZA Issue 4, an installation guide for the ONT that draws this housing: Table 4-3 p34 names it (Outdoor enclosure, 3FE54221AH, with a Phoenix connector and a Molex to Phoenix power cable adapter), Figure 5-10 p54 draws it closed, Figure 5-11 p55 open and empty, Figure 5-13 p57 with the ONT seated. All three are vector line art, read at 600 dpi. Five reseller photographs of the sibling 3FE54221AC, 5120 px, all taken at an angle: construction and colour only. No datasheet or drawing that dimensions the housing was found.
